title: Interview capacity & headcount sync - scratchpad
content:
Quick notes for 1:1 + weekly hiring sync (scratchpad)

Context / goal:
- Align on available interview capacity for next 6 weeks and any urgent role reshuffles.
- Decide which reqs to de-prioritize vs accelerate (risk of missing Q1 delivery if backfilled late).
- Actionable follow-ups for recruiting ops and hiring managers.

Current headcount snapshot (candidate-level shorthand):
- IC Software Eng (Backend): 4 open (2 active pipeline, 2 new reqs)
- ML Infra Eng: 2 open (1 strong lead, 1 passive outreach)
- Product Manager: 1 open (paused; hiring manager asked to re-scope)
- SRE: 3 open (high priority for Dedicated team)

Capacity notes (interviewers & windows):
- Week of Nov 11: limited due to holiday in APAC — reduce onsite rounds to 2 per candidate where possible.
- Panel fatigue: Eng-leads flagged that panels >90m are dropping acceptance rate. Recommend shift to 60m + take-home.
- Interviewer roster: need 2 more senior ML infra interviewers for loop parity; ask infra leads for rotation coverage.

Bottlenecks observed:
- Loop length: average loop now 28 days from screen->offer for Eng roles (target 18–21).
- Interview no-shows: 7% in past month — create short confirmation + calendar buffer step.
- Debrief delays: hiring managers taking >48h to post-interview feedback for 35% of candidates causing drop-off.

Proposed changes to reduce cycle time:
1) Trim onsite loops: replace one panel with an async code exercise for backend roles.
2) Standardize debrief template (one-pager) and require submission within 24h or risk auto-close.
3) Introduce "fast lane" for mission-critical roles (SRE x2, ML Infra x1) — recruiter + hiring manager weekly triage.
4) Interviewer incentives: rotate interview credits (time bank) and highlight in eng all-hands.

Questions to ask hiring managers in sync:
- Which reqs can be paused this quarter without blocking product milestones?
- Which role(s) are critical hires vs nice-to-have? Prioritize explicitly.
- Are there internal candidates we should move through a faster loop?
- Will the team accept a compressed loop (take-home + 1x 60m panel) for candidates with strong org fit?

Draft agenda for hiring sync (30 minutes)
- 0:00–0:03 quick headcount recap (me)
- 0:03–0:10 urgent role review (managers)
- 0:10–0:18 capacity constraints & interviewer availability (ops)
- 0:18–0:25 decide fast-lane roles + action owners
- 0:25–0:30 assign follow-ups + due dates

Pre-reads to drop in calendar invite:
- Link: https://confluence.redwood.io/display/ENG/Headcount+Plan+FY25 (ask Aisha to attach the latest tab)
- Current pipeline snapshot (export from Greenhouse) — include short table of top 10 candidates

Follow-up action items (to assign during sync)
- Recruiter (Omar) -> create fast-lane tag in ATS and route candidates for SRE + ML Infra by EOD Fri (due: Nov 8)
- Hiring manager (K-run) -> confirm if Product Manager role can be paused or re-specified (due: Nov 12)
- Eng leads -> nominate 2 interviewers each for ML infra rotation (due: Nov 10)
- Ops -> implement debrief one-pager template and add to post-interview workflow (owner: me, due: Nov 14)
- Recruiting -> test calendar confirmation + 24h reminder to reduce no-shows (owner: Omar, pilot week Nov 11)

Debrief template (quick draft to iterate)
- Candidate name / IDX: 
- Role & Hiring manager: 
- Core strengths (bullets): 
- Concerns / gaps (bullets): 
- Recommended outcome (hire / no-hire / hire with follow-up)
- Recommended level & comp band: 
- Clear decision owner (name) + deadline for final decision

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: reduced panel depth may surface regressions on system design.
  -> Mitigation: targeted phone with senior architect for high-risk candidates only.
- Risk: interviewer burnout if rotation not enforced.
  -> Mitigation: temporary hiring freeze for low-priority reqs, increase rotation pool.

Notes to self (scratchy):
- Ping infra leads in #infra-ops about 2 interviewer nominations (use DM if no reply in 24h).
- Update FY25 headcount spreadsheet to reflect paused PM req and reallocate to SRE if approved.
- Consider small hiring event for SREs (contractor -> perm conversion pipeline).

Open questions to resolve before sync:
- Do we have budget buffer to accelerate 2 SRE hires via contractor conversion? (Finance ask: who owns this ask?)
- If PM is re-scoped, can we change IC mapping or does it require new req? (ask product ops)

Short checklist before meeting:
- [ ] Attach pipeline CSV to invite
- [ ] Draft fast-lane tag + flow in ATS (Omar to confirm)
- [ ] Share debrief template in invite notes
- [ ] Add decision owners column to headcount sheet

End of scratchpad — will prune and convert into tidy agenda + meeting doc after sync.

Random micro-notes (to capture quick ideas):
- Could try 2-hour weekend interviewer block for concentrated debriefs (controversial).
- Small hiring bonus for internal referrals for SRE this quarter only.

---
Revision history (scratch):
- 2024-11-06: initial draft (created)
- 2024-12-10: added debrief template + updated follow-ups after convo with Omar
